extracted.name: Sandwich Bread (from All-purpose Baking Mix)
extracted.description: 3 net carbs Recipe from Wheat Belly Cook Book **Follow the recipe for All-purpose Baking Mix that I have to make this bread. **This bread is quite dense so probably won't make it again.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 c butter or coconut oil, melted
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease 9x5 loaf pan.
In large bowl, combine baking mix, baking powder and salt. Add egg yolks, butter or oil and milk. Mix well.
In another large bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Pour egg whites into flour mixture and gently fold in. Spread into loaf pan and bake 30 min. or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.
